TLINE.TDLINE: &USE&
Setup Debugging points by timed loops. These are especiall helpful
during the development of external interfaces. As especially a
synchroneous interfaces might not catch external breakpoints (IDOC
processing, qRFC, tRFC). The developer can include a timed debugging
point and when it is activated via this customizing, the system will
enter a holding for a specified time.
&PRECONDITIONS&
The developer needs to add the debugging point via the following coding:
/S4P0/CL_ENH_UTILS=>DEBUG_VIA_LOOP( '<Name of debugging point>'
The debugging point can be a freely given name with max. 30 characters.
This single call will create the customizing entry itself as inactive
entry.
&STANDARD_SETUP&
The standard setup is created automatically as inactive debugging point
with 60 seconds holding time. A meaningful description might be added
manually.
&ACTIVITY&
If you want to activate the debugging point, you only have to set the
checkbox "DebugOn" and adjust the ValidTo for a future timestamp. That
is done to prevent a permanent holding loop that is in general bad for
overall systemperformance. Additionally you can specify the user for
what the debugging point should be active (optional).
When the interface is called, it will hold for the specified time
(standard is 60 secs). In transaction SM50 or SM66 you will see the
process counting the time up and there you can (authorization provided)
debug into the process. Use for that in SM50 the menu point
"Administration->Program->Debugging".
